original_question: Construct a convincing computer visualization of the Julia set of a Cremer polynomial f_lambda(z) = lambda z + z^2, where theta is irrational and the map is not analytically conjugate to a rotation near 0.
target_in_paper: §1, Question 3 of "Local connectivity of Julia sets": "Make a good computer picture of the Julia set of some Cremer polynomial." ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the relevant quadratic family f_λ(z)=λz+z^2, the irrational neutral fixed-point setting at 0, the Cremer condition as failure of analytic conjugacy to a rotation near 0, and the fact that the paper's target here is a computer rendering of the Julia set rather than a broader structural question. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
missing_details: The paper fixes the parameter as λ=exp(2πiθ); that normalization should be stated explicitly to match the paper's setup. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
The ambient setting is the complex plane, z∈ℂ, and the object to be visualized is specifically the Julia set J(f_λ). ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))

The official formulation is existential: it asks for a picture of the Julia set of some Cremer polynomial, not of an arbitrary or every Cremer polynomial. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))

The statement belongs to §1 and is distinct from the neighboring Question 2 about a topological model and Questions 4-6 about ray landing, accessibility, and connected components, so the rewrite should stay narrowly on visualization. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))

To make the question fully stand-alone, it helps to say that 0 is the fixed point around which local analytic linearization fails in the Cremer case. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
refined_question: Can one make a good computer picture of the Julia set J(f_λ) for some Cremer quadratic polynomial f_λ(z)=λz+z^2 on ℂ, where λ=e^{2π i θ} with θ irrational and f_λ is not analytically conjugate near the fixed point 0 to the rotation z↦λz? ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
justification: The draft is aimed at the visualization problem in the paper's first section, and the exact nearest official formulation is Question 3. The surrounding setup on the same page defines the family f_λ(z)=λz+z^2, the parameter λ=e^{2πiθ}, and the Siegel/Cremer distinction via analytic conjugacy near 0. The nearby questions show that the paper treats visualization separately from topological modeling and from accessibility/landing questions, so the refined version should remain only about producing a computer picture of a Julia set for some Cremer parameter. ([web.pdx.edu](https://web.pdx.edu/~veerman/bielefeld.pdf))
